alfred-dff.note: ALFRED vintage pulls at three dates, kept to study revisions: not a daily series with a first print per day

alfred-dff-first-print.note: ALFRED pulls at five dates, kept to study first prints: not a daily series

alfred-h41-first-print.note: ALFRED first-print pulls around three dates: a revision study, not a daily series

alfred-ioer.note: ALFRED vintage pulls at three dates: IORB/IOER is read from the NY Fed and the announcements table

alfred-rrpontsyd.note: ALFRED vintage pulls at dated vintages: on_rrp is read from the Desk's results

alfred-wlrrafoial.note: ALFRED vintage pulls (H.4.1 reverse repos, foreign official): a revision study, no daily first prints

alfred-wlrral.note: ALFRED vintage pulls (H.4.1 reverse repos): a revision study, no daily first prints

alfred-wlrraol.note: ALFRED vintage pulls (H.4.1 reverse repos, other): a revision study, no daily first prints

alfred-wresbal.note: ALFRED vintage pulls: reserve_balances is read from the FRED latest-vintage snapshot under the registry's declared lag

alfred-wtregen.note: ALFRED vintage pulls at four dates: tga is read from the FRED latest-vintage snapshot under the registry's declared lag

dts_inputs.note: tga_daily, the daily Treasury General Account balance, and its change

frb_ddp.note: the Board's H.15 and PRATES SDMX files, read only by repo_model.effr_history for the pre-SOFR study; EFFR and IOER are already read from the NY Fed and FRED, and the primary credit rate is a step series set by the policy register

funding_inputs.note: NY Fed SOFR/TGCR/BGCR rates and volumes, FRED H.4.1 weeklies (reserves, TGA), Treasury bills and settlement: the published panel's columns

nyfed-primary-dealer.note: a hand-downloaded 'latest' CSV with no recorded retrieval time (its manifest says 'None'): the as-of rule cannot say when any row was public; its weekly positions are the FR 2004's, already read

nyfed-rrp-results.note: the Desk's ON RRP operation results the on_rrp column is built from

ofr_inputs.note: OFR repo segment rates (ofr_tri_rate, ofr_gcf_rate, ofr_dvp_rate) and the DVP-segment columns

on_rrp_inputs.note: on_rrp, the Desk's ON RRP operation results

repo_ops_inputs.note: the Desk's repo operations (fed_repo_* columns, both availability readings)

srf_inputs.note: srf_take_up, the standing repo facility take-up

treasury_auctions.note: gross settlement columns of the published panel (treasury_settlement*)

treasury_bill_rates_page.note: the Treasury text-view page as served: evidence for #445 (its 3:30 pm quote time), not a data input; no series is built from it

treasury_bills.note: Treasury bill rates (tbill_4w, tbill_13w), by year
